title: Concrete Expanded
description: Get more variants of concrete like- stairs, slabs & more!
body:
# **MORE CONCRETE!** # 

Tired of the limited concrete blocks in vanilla Minecraft? You need just a basic colored stair?
You're lucky because this mod solves all this problems!

This mod expands on concrete by adding slabs, stairs & walls for every concrete varient as builders and casual players always wanted.

It helps with solid colors, pixel art and so much more building mechanics.

** **
All the blocks can be crafted usong the deafult stairs, slabs and walls recipe and can be gotten in the _Concrete Expanded_ creative tab.
